skill_name: If you needed to produce a report quickly, what steps would you undertake?
workflow: If I needed to produce a report quickly, I would identify the scope and purpose of the report, then start gathering and organizing relevant data. I would then create an outline with the main points of the report, and prioritize which information needs to be included. After that, I would review the material and write the main body of the report. Finally, I would proofread my work and make sure that it is well-structured, clear, and concise.
